[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned using the 50/30/20 rule for budgeting: 50% for essential expenses, 30% for discretionary spending, and 20% for saving and debt repayment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended practicing mindful shopping by asking specific questions about the purchase.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested finding free alternatives, using cashback and rewards programs, and regularly reviewing spending habits.
